subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to inform you about an important update regarding your upcoming flight reservation. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a slight change in the departure time of your flight. Your new departure time is now at 10:30 AM instead of the previously scheduled time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any concerns or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing to fly with us. Safe travels, The airline team
